text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High token counts detected for tenant 'logica' in VPC-dedicated pool (pool-id: dp-47). Generated ticket INC-2329. Paging on-call SRE and ML oncall.

sara: paging in. seeing a sudden jump in per-request tokens for logica starting ~14:02 UTC. CPU/GPU usage fine, but per-token billing alarm triggered.

dan: I'm on it. pulling logs from the serving runtime and the request inspector. any downstream changes from customer? @account-exec any heads up?

beth: account says customer shipped a data export last night that contains lots of escaped unicode. they updated their ingestion SDK to v2.3.

mike: attaching a snippet of the request payload sample showing lots of zero-width joiners and emoji sequences that expanded tokenization.

alice: quick note — this is only impacting the VPC dedicated pool for Logica; hosted customers unaffected.

oncall-ml: initial hypothesis: tokenizer encoding differences (NFKC/NFD) caused the tokenizer upgrade to split sequences differently -> token multiplier x3-x6 depending on strings.

sara: confirm. here's a short log excerpt from the tokenizer service (redacted):
```
2026-03-15T14:03:12Z GET /v1/generate tenant=logica model=llama-65b sequence_length=1024 tokens=2048 encoded=6487
2026-03-15T14:03:14Z GET /v1/generate tenant=logica model=llama-65b sequence_length=1024 tokens=2050 encoded=6521
```
shows encoded token count >> reported token param.

dan: thanks. I also see a spike in encoder-timeouts in the preprocessor container around the same time. can we mitigate at the proxy level to avoid extra billing and protect SLOs?

oncall-ml: mitigation options: 1) server-side normalization to NFKC before tokenization, 2) force legacy tokenizer variant for logica (tokenizer=v1_legacy) in routing rules, 3) ask customer to revert SDK change. fastest is #2 + local normalization as a stopgap.

sara: agree. will enact routing override to pin logica to tokenizer=v1_legacy in the dedicated pool. dan can you prepare the route change? I'll coordinate with billing.

dan: applying route override now. command I ran:
```
# route override, pinned tokenizer for tenant logica
redwood route update --tenant logica --pool dp-47 --override "tokenizer=v1_legacy" --reason "incident INC-2329 temporary mitigation"
```
applied to 2/3 replicas, rolling to last replica. monitoring.

beth: deployed normalization middleware patch to the preprocessor in the canary group (python snippet):
```
# unicode normalize before tokenization
import unicodedata
text = unicodedata.normalize('NFKC', text)
```
canary shows token counts back to expected range.

mike: good. engaged support-bot to open a billing hold for logica to prevent automated overcharge while we investigate.

support-bot: Billing hold placed for tenant=logica, hold-id=BH-778. Invoices paused; credits will be applied retroactively if needed.

oncall-ml: post-mitigation numbers: token multiplier dropped from ~4.3x to ~1.1x for sample set. GPU latency unaffected. looks like tokenizer variant mismatch + unicode form.

sara: next steps: 1) keep route override and normalization for 3 hours while we coordinate with customer, 2) run a tokenization-diff job over a representative corpus to estimate overbilling, 3) prepare credits & CS communication.

dan: I'm creating a canary rollback playbook in the incident channel in case route update causes regressions. also scheduling a canary to remove override in 2 hrs to validate stability.

account-exec: I'll message the Logica CSM and lead engineer immediately: heads-up about our temporary mitigation and that we'll credit any excess billing. keeping them in the loop.

beth: flagging a follow-up for eng-ml: we should add tokenizer variant compatibility tests into the model onboarding checks for VPC customers (especially for dedicated pools).

mike: removing the old tokenizer default from the config store after PM sync is risky; prefer adding explicit compatibility mapping per-tenant. filing RFC.

alice: for the incident postmortem: please capture root cause (customer SDK changed normalization + our routing applied new tokenizer by default on rolling deploy), impact (billing spike for logica, temporary risk to quota enforcement), mitigations (route override, normalization patch, billing hold), and action items (compat tests, tenant-level mapping, customer comms).

support-bot: INC-2329 updated: status=mitigated, severity=high -> monitoring.

sara: handing off to daytime SRE team for follow-through. on-call handoff note: mitigation in place, billing hold active, customer notified. Dan will perform final checks; reopen paging if counts degrade >5% from current baseline.

dan: acknowledged handoff. leaving monitoring alerts at reduced sensitivity to avoid noise. I'll post final status update in 30m.

oncall-ml: for the record, root cause hypothesis: tokenizer default change in our model packaging pipeline got rolled into dp-47 during a routine deploy; Logica's SDK data shape and unicode combinations made the new tokenizer break into many more tokens. will add telemetry to detect large token multipliers per-tenant automatically.

account-exec: Logica replied, appreciates the quick mitigation and accepts credits. asked for a short postmortem and a permanent config mapping so their future SDK updates won't re-trigger this.

sara: noted. closing out in 1 hour if no regressions. final timestamps logged to INC-2329.

support-bot: Incident INC-2329 closed by sara at 2026-03-15T15:47:14Z (auto-close scheduled).
